blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The Ateneo de Zamboanga University (AdZU) College of Law on Thursday condemned the deadly attack on Regional Trial Court (RTC) Judge Joseph Wee Sit, calling on authorities to ensure swift justice for the victim. In a statement, the Jesuit-run law school expressed deep grief over the killing of Wee Sit, who served as the presiding judge of RTC Branch 2 in Isabela City, Basilan. “He should have reached his courtroom. He should have returned home to his family,” the statement read. The law school pointed out that attacks against members of the bench “strike at […]...
